classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a direct video recording of a parliamentary debate, created at the time of the event by the Council of States.
classification.resume: The document is a parliamentary record of the Swiss Council of States (Ständerat) from the Winter Session 2011, containing a debate on a federal law concerning measures for internal security. It includes a speech by Hans Altherr. The record is a video recording of the proceedings.
